name: Ptarmigan Traverse
descent_text: From White Rock Lakes or Itswoot Ridge area, descend steeply through gullies and snowfields over Dana Glacier toward Bachelor Creek. Follow Bachelor Creek north down the canyon, navigating log-crossing sections through recovering burned forest. The maintained Downey Creek Trail eventually becomes a clear 4-5 mile path dropping 1,600+ feet through timber to the trailhead. Total descent time: 8-12 hours depending on route and conditions. Alternative: consider an out-and-back option from Cascade Pass heading south to White Rock Lakes and returning, due to 2025/2026 winter damage to southern road access.
